channels.title: Reddit & Community Manual Workflow Pain
channels.objective: Catch users describing repetitive copy-paste, spreadsheet glue, or hours wasted.
queries: site:reddit.com "freelance workflows" ("is there a tool" OR "i spend hours" OR "manually")
site:reddit.com "freelance workflows" ("tedious" OR "nightmare" OR "waste of time" OR "spreadsheet")
site:reddit.com "freelance workflows" ("how do you automate" OR "copy paste" OR "every week")
channels.what_to_save: Verbatim complaint quote, user role/context, trigger frequency, and link with date.

channels.title: Capterra & G2 1-to-3 Star Software Reviews
channels.objective: Find paying software users frustrated by clunky UX, manual imports, or missing smart automation.
queries: site:capterra.com "freelance workflows" ("import" OR "formatting" OR "template" OR "too many clicks")
site:g2.com "freelance workflows" ("What do you dislike" OR "manual entry" OR "export")
channels.what_to_save: Incumbent software name, exact 'Cons' quote, and the manual workaround users are forced to do.

channels.title: Indie Hackers Revenue Proofs & Product Hunt Launch Comments
channels.objective: Verify solo-founder willingness-to-pay ($500-$5,000/mo) and unserved edge cases in launch comments.
queries: site:producthunt.com "freelance workflows" ("does it support" OR "can it handle" OR "alternative")
channels.what_to_save: One-line value proposition, pricing tier, first customer acquisition channel, and unmet comment requests.

channels.title: Upwork & Fiverr Paid Repetitive Human Tasks
channels.objective: Spot recurring manual data processing tasks where clients already pay humans per batch.
queries: site:fiverr.com "freelance workflows" ("data entry" OR "formatting" OR "summary" OR "audit")
channels.what_to_save: Exact raw input files provided by the client and the exact deliverable format expected back.

ranked_clues.quote: Client hired me for a landing page: $2,000 for 20 hours of work (my rate is $100/hr). Then the extras started: 'Can you add a blog section?' (+10 hours), 'Actually let's change the entire color scheme' (+8 hours), 'One more revision on the copy' (+5 hours). I kept saying yes because I didn't want to lose the client... five_step_validation.name: Talk to 10 Real Target Users About Current Behavior
five_step_validation.action: Recruit 10 Fixed-price freelance web developers and UI/UX designers and ask how they currently handle 'Signed project scope/contract PDF + incoming client email or message'. Verify they already use a manual patch (spreadsheet, scripts, or unpaid overtime).

five_step_validation.name: Benchmark Against Current Workaround Friction
five_step_validation.action: Ensure the AI workflow produces 'Out-of-scope flag + polite change-order quote draft + one-click payment link' in <60 seconds with zero manual template setup, beating spreadsheets and bloated incumbent tools.

five_step_validation.name: Run Payment / Deposit Commitment Test
five_step_validation.action: Present a concierge demo or landing page with a paid pilot/pre-order button. Pass threshold: >10% conversion = strong signal; 5-10% = refine segment; <5% = pivot.

five_step_validation.name: Bottom-Up Market Sizing
five_step_validation.action: Multiply reachable target segment count x willingness-to-pay conversion rate x annual subscription ARPU.

five_step_validation.name: Lock In Non-Trivial Defensibility (Moat)
five_step_validation.action: Accumulate domain-specific edge-case benchmarks, vertical workflow integrations, and user correction loops so generic chat wrappers cannot replicate the reliability.
